review=out/'review'
before=review/'groups.input.svg'
candidate=review/'groups.candidate.svg'
original=before.read_text()
edited=candidate.read_text()
source_tree=ET.fromstring(original)
candidate_tree=ET.fromstring(edited)
tag='{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}'
before_part=source_tree.find("./"+tag+"g[@id='forearm_surface']")
after_part=candidate_tree.find("./"+tag+"g[@id='forearm_surface']")
description=after_part.find(tag+'desc')
assert description is not None
desc_text=description.text
after_part.remove(description)
assert ET.tostring(source_tree)==ET.tostring(candidate_tree), 'Only the part desc may change'
assert candidate_tree.attrib==source_tree.attrib
assert ET.tostring(source_tree.find("./"+tag+"g[@id='forearm']"))==ET.tostring(candidate_tree.find("./"+tag+"g[@id='forearm']"))
ids=[n.get('id') for n in candidate_tree.iter() if n.get('id')]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
bindings=[n for n in candidate_tree.iter() if n.get('data-part-path')]
assert len(bindings)==1
assert bindings[0].get('data-part-path')=='forearm/forearm_surface'
assert bindings[0].tag==tag+'g' and bindings[0].get('id')
paths=list(after_part.iter(tag+'path'))
assert len(paths)==1
for shape in paths:
 assert shape.get('stroke')=='none'
 assert shape.get('fill')=='#75b9ae'
 assert shape.get('d').strip().endswith(('Z','z'))

patch=json.loads((out/'children.json').read_text())
assert patch=={'groups':[],'parts':[]}
assert json.loads((review/'groups.merged.json').read_text())==json.loads((root/'structure/groups.json').read_text())
hashes=json.loads((review/'input-sha256.json').read_text())
for rel,digest in hashes.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest, 'Input changed before delivery: '+rel
bounds=json.loads((out/'轮廓检查.json').read_text())
assert bounds['status']=='pass'
assert bounds['results'][0]['outside_samples']==0
with Image.open(review/'preview.candidate.png') as im:
 assert im.mode=='RGB' and im.size==(300,500)
 assert all(im.getpixel(pt)==(255,255,255) for pt in [(0,0),(299,0),(0,499),(299,499)])
with Image.open(review/'comparison-board.png') as im:
 # The bound preview tool's eighth panel is the before/after absolute difference.
 # Its 28px label is excluded; full black means all RGB pixels match.
 difference=im.crop((900,556,1200,1056))
 assert difference.getbbox() is None

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shutil
root=Path.cwd()

review=out/'review'
assert json.loads((review/'self-check.json').read_text())['status']=='pass'
assert json.loads((out/'轮廓检查.json').read_text())['status']=='pass'
manifest=json.loads((review/'input-sha256.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'block-layers/groups.svg').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==manifest['block-layers/groups.svg']
for source,target in [(review/'groups.candidate.svg',root/'block-layers/groups.svg'),(review/'preview.candidate.png',root/'block-layers/preview.png')]:
 staged=target.with_name('.'+target.name+'.motion-delivery.tmp')
 shutil.copyfile(source,staged)
 os.replace(staged,target)
 assert source.read_bytes()==target.read_bytes()
for name in ['references/reference.png','structure/groups.json']:
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==manifest[name]
outputs=[out/'children.json',root/'block-layers/groups.svg',root/'block-layers/preview.png',out/'轮廓检查.json']
delivery={
 'status':'delivered',
 'node':'part_motion_completion',
 'worker':'group_motion_completion',
 'group_path':'forearm',
 'new_parts':0,
 'original_tree_unchanged':True,
 'original_reference_unchanged':True,
 'published_files_match_reviewed_candidates':True,
 'outputs':{str(f.relative_to(root)):{'bytes':f.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in outputs},
 'input_guide_backup':str((review/'groups.input.svg').relative_to(root)),
 'self_check':str((review/'self-check.json').relative_to(root))
}
(review/'delivery.json').write_text(json.dumps(delivery,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
